verdict.rationale: Lago documents outbound webhooks. The docs cover HMAC signature verification, automatic re-delivery up to 3 times on non-2xx or network errors, a log for inspecting and retrying generated webhook events, and a versioning policy that covers new webhook event types. missing for 10: an explicit quote showing how a webhook endpoint URL is registered, an enumerated catalog of subscribable event types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: If you return an error (other than a 2xx's HTTP response) or if there is a network issue, the webhook will be sent again. Lago will try to send the webhook 3 times.
The second is `HMAC`, which features a shorter payload header and no size restrictions.
This allows you to take a closer look at the generated events, detect possible errors, and retry them.
Clients should tolerate additive changes within v1, including new response fields, enum values, endpoints, optional request fields, and webhook event types.
